simple.meaning: מְלֵאָה (mᵉlêʼâh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “something fulfilled , i.e. abundance (of produce).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Exodus 22:28. The surrounding context includes family line, offering, faith, city.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מְלֵאָה (H4395) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.

definitions.full: H4395. meleah מְלֵאָה noun feminine fulness, full produce ; — ׳מ Num 18:27 ; Deut 22:9 ; מְלֵאָֽתְךָ Exod 22:28 ; = full produce of field 22:28 , ׳מ הַזֶּרַע the full produce of the seed Deut 22:9 ; of winepress Num 18:27 .

occurrences.englishText: “You shall not blaspheme God, nor curse a ruler of your people.
Your wave offering shall be credited to you, as though it were the grain of the threshing floor, and as the fullness of the wine press.
You shall not sow your vineyard with two kinds of seed, lest all the fruit be defiled, the seed which you have sown, and the increase of the vineyard.
After him was Shammah the son of Agee a Hararite. The Philistines had gathered together into a troop, where there was a plot of ground full of lentils; and the people fled from the Philistines.
How the faithful city has become a prostitute!
You that are full of shouting, a tumultuous city, a joyous town; your slain are not slain with the sword, neither are they dead in battle.
Behold,† “Behold”, from “הִנֵּה”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection. I will crush you in your place,
Woe to the bloody city! It is all full of lies and robbery. The prey doesn’t depart.
